hero.heading: Where Crustates is going.
hero.lead: Each milestone ends with one working machine, not a pile of half-finished features. Dates are deliberately absent until M0 ships.

later.heading: After M6, in no fixed order.
later.lead: Experimental features stay opt-in until they are stable upstream.

vote.title: Vote in Discussions
vote.body: Upvote ideas or start one in GitHub Discussions. We review the top requests every milestone.

rfc.title: Write an RFC
rfc.body: Bigger changes start as an RFC pull request. Accepted RFCs become Architecture Decision Records.

issue.title: Pick up an issue
issue.body: Issues labelled good first issue are a quick way into the codebase.
